links.outcome: Mortality model performance on an external hospital cohort compared with the development site
links.effect: On the 45-patient Košice cohort, the model reached ROC AUC 83.6% and accuracy 73.3%. On the development data the simplified model had AUC 83.6% and accuracy 80.5%. AUC held but accuracy fell.
links.quote: This test resulted in a ROC AUC score of 83.6% and an overall prediction accuracy of 73.3%.

unlisted_practices: Using SHAP values (XAI) to identify important features and explain model predictions
Simplifying models to a reduced set of top features for deployment in a web application
Testing the deployed model with medical experts

screen.reason: Evaluates ML models for COVID-19 severity and mortality with SHAP-based XAI and user testing of a web-based decision support tool by medical experts, but does not compare outcomes of a deployment safeguard or practice.
